  Machine Learning [CSE-4032]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Differentiate between Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning Provide  
  examples of real-world tasks that fall under each category and discuss how machine  
  (5)  
  learning techniques are applied in these scenarios.  
  A)  
  B)      Make use of ensemble methods like Random Forests or Gradient Boosting help in  
  reducing overfitting compared to individual models like decision trees.                     (5)  
  
  2)           Critically assess the limitations of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) in capturing the  
  underlying structure of high-dimensional data. Discuss alternative dimensionality  
  reduction techniques and their potential advantages over PCA in preserving non-linear (5)  
  A)      relationships and handling outliers.  
  
  B)      Investigate the interpretability of SVM models trained with different kernels. How do  
  different kernels affect the interpretability of decision boundaries and feature importance  
  in SVM models? Are there trade-offs between model complexity and interpretability           (5)  
  associated with kernel selection.  
  
  3)           Evaluate the main steps of the K-means clustering algorithm, examining processes such  
  as initialization, cluster assignment, and centroid updating.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Critically analyze the concept of the bias-variance tradeoff in machine learning. Provide  
  a detailed explanation of how model complexity influences bias and variance, and          (5)  
  discuss strategies to strike an optimal balance between them.  
  
  4)           Critically evaluate the suitability of Q-learning for solving complex decision-making  
  problems with large state and action spaces. Discuss its limitations and propose  
  (5)  
  enhancements or alternative algorithms that can overcome these limitations.  
  A)  
  B)      Make the convergence properties of the value iteration algorithm. Under what conditions  
  does value iteration converge, and what factors might influence its convergence rate.   (5)
